Serve the local web interface

Usage: papyrus browser [--host <host>] [--port <port>] [--no-open] [--debug]

Options:
      --host <host>    Bind address. Default: 127.0.0.1
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --port <port>    TCP port. Default: 6420
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-open        Do not open the default browser automatically
      --debug          Log one line per received request to stderr
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
